cumulative_distinct_original_module_test.scope: Separate isolated original modules; earlier Progress concurrent test failed current=99 expected=100. Not full workspace.

findings: Duplicate benchmark uses b.iter returning detect_duplicates future without await/block_on; the async function body is not executed. Source also uses identical duplicate_detection group/input IDs for quick and full functions. No Criterion benchmark run or timing accepted.

Authored actual-detector control: await on equal files yields group1; construct another future while files exist, remove both before polling, then await yields group0. Establishes deferred hashing with actual unchanged detector/models, not a measurement of Criterion itself.

Duplicate benchmark creates only synthetic MediaFile records and supplied hash strings for /tmp paths, no physical files. Detector unconditionally rehashes eligible paths rather than trusting supplied hashes. Await alone would not turn this fixture into a valid disk-throughput benchmark.

Scanner benchmark does create real temporary files and block_on scan_directory; setup is iter_batched. It measures metadata/media scanning with identical short fake image bytes, not duplicate hashing or decoding. No result-count assertions or benchmark execution here.

Organizer benchmark synthesizes /tmp source paths without creating source files; TempDir destination owner is dropped before the timed closure because omitted from setup return tuple. Thus it does not establish successful movement throughput. Not executed against arbitrary /tmp paths.

Scanner integration tests use in-memory DB, synthetic extension-tagged files and happy-path counts; hidden-files test explicitly expects zero because temporary root has hidden ancestor. Does not demonstrate exclusion limited to hidden descendants. Source reviewed; integration tests not executed.

System workflow creates synthetic media by byte labels/zero padding, calls FileOrganizer::new with dirs::config_dir(), and checks several weak conditions: lowercase exists rather than all extensions, year-or-Videos after Videos already asserted. Cache checks compare counts without validating stored hashes. Not run because global config scope needs isolation.

FileManager simply replaces an Arc slice and clones shared handles; 10 original tests passed. Tests named filter behavior do not implement filtering, one reset test has no post-operation assertion. Timing assertion under100ms is not a throughput qualification.
format_bytes uses binary1024 scaling with labels KB through TB and f64 display; all13 original tests passed. Display utility only, no physical freed-space proof.

main initializes logs in current directory and truncates log each launch; enables raw terminal before awaiting App::new. An App::new error returns before explicit cleanup, absent a terminal guard in main. Static review only; no terminal or full TUI launch.
